issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares the attribute 'excellencyLevel' as type double, but the solution implementation defines it as int in src/de/tum/in/ase/ExcellenceLand.java. This inconsistency affects the constructor parameter type and the getter return type, and will confuse students about which type to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the code with the UML specification: change the 'excellencyLevel' field, constructor parameter, and getter to type double in ExcellenceLand.java (both template and solution). Alternatively, if int was intended, update the UML/problem statement to specify int for 'excellencyLevel'.
